This is first application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail in relation to FIR No.610/2022 registered at Police Station Civil Lines, District Rewa (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 419, 420, 465, 467, 468, 471, 120B/34 of IPC.
2.

entities.text: Police Station Civil Lines, District Rewa
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and falsely being implicated in the case.
It is submitted by him that false registry has been done in name of applicant.
He was not aware of same and was administered some stupefying substances.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3 . Learned Government Advocate appearing for State opposed the prayer for grant of bail.
4. Heard the counsel for the parties.

opennyai_summary.decision:
Applicant is in jail since 25 .11.2022.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.
In view of same, bail application filed by applicant is dismissed.
